1. Claim 4 (Original)

2. Claim 5 (Currently Amended) Use of the composition of claim 1 for preparation of a blocking vaccine to impede Leishmaniasis transmission in humans, wherein said composition comprises Fucose Mannose Ligand (FML) fractions or sub-fractions derived from __Leishmania chagasi or Leishmania infantum__ promastigotes or amastigotes and saponin, and wherein said composition is formulated to elicit blocking antibodies in humans at therapeutic concentrations lower than 400 μg/ml.

3. Claim 6 (Currently Amended) Use of the composition of claim 1 for preparation of a reagent for blocking Leishmaniasis transmission in humans or animals, wherein said composition further comprises suitable pharmacological vehicles, and wherein the FML is derived from __Leishmania chagasi or Leishmania infantum__ and is formulated to produce blocking antibodies capable of impeding transmission by sandfly vectors.

4. Claim 7 (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 1, wherein the Leishmania __chagasi or Leishmania infantum__ promastigotes or amastigotes fractions called "Fucose Mannose Ligand" (FML) comprise a glycoprotein complex containing 29% of neutral sugar, 44% of protein, 11% of phosphate and hexoamines traces composed by protein bands with molecular weight ranging from 9 to 95 kDa, some protein bands having carbohydrates at 36 and 54 to 68 kDa, the FML glycidic portion presenting 10% of fucose and 47% of mannose, 30% of glucose, 12% of galactose and xylose traces, amino acids containing 10 to 20% of glutamic acid, alanine, aspartic acid and glycine, 5 to 10% of serine, histidine, lysine, leucine, threonine, proline and valine, and 2 to 5% of arginine, methionine, isoleucine, tyrosine and phenylalanine, __and wherein said composition is formulated for administration to humans to elicit a protective immune response and blocking antibodies that impede transmission of human visceral leishmaniasis__.
